settings.editor: What are cloud security managed services?

settings.title: Protect your cloud from first configuration to final response

settings.editor: Cloud security managed services combine the controls, processes and expertise needed to protect your cloud identities, configurations, workloads, data and infrastructure.

Strong cloud security goes beyond securing individual workloads. It brings together posture management, identity protection, configuration reviews, workload and container security, monitoring and incident response, so risks get caught and your whole environment stays protected.

settings.editor: Find weaknesses across configurations, identities, workloads and controls before they turn into bigger risks.
Review identities, permissions, authentication and privileged access to control who reaches your cloud resources.
Use cloud logging and monitoring to see activity across your entire environment.
Find security weaknesses across workloads, containers, images, configurations and runtime environments.
Put clear processes in place for investigating, containing, escalating and responding to cloud incidents.
Connect with our security team to scope your monitoring environment.

settings.title: Why a well-run cloud can still be an insecure one

settings.editor: Cloud management keeps your infrastructure running. Cloud security makes sure it’s protected.
A well-managed cloud can still have excessive permissions, exposed resources, insecure configurations, gaps in logging or vulnerable workloads.
The two work best together, but they solve different problems.
